items.title: Double-Digit Year/Year South Central Natural Gas Storage Deficit Endures
items.summary: Natural gas stored in the South Central region closed out the final full week of September below the five-year average and far from year-earlier levels, despite record production in the Permian Basin.

items.title: SoCal Natural Gas Prices Defy Weekend Sell-Off as Pipeline Constraints Bite
items.summary: Spot natural gas prices fell broadly Friday as traders priced a three-day weekend package into mild early-October demand, though Southern California bucked the trend as pipeline constraints combined with lingering heat to support the region.

items.title: Asia Retakes LNG Premium Over Europe as Mild Weather Curbs Heating Demand
items.summary: Mild forecasts across Europe and a warmer outlook for North Asia are holding back early-season heating demand, as Asian buyers pull ahead of Europe in the competition for flexible US cargoes.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Claw Back $3 Amid Pipeline Outage, Cooler Weather Support
items.summary: Natural gas futures clawed back the $3.00/MMBtu threshold Friday, with the prompt month reversing sharply from an early sell-off as pipeline uncertainty and approaching cooler weather provided support against a still-loose fundamental backdrop.

items.title: October Heat Wave Poised to Extend California Natural Gas Price Rally
items.summary: California natural gas demand is poised to jump over the coming week as an October heat wave settles over the state, extending support for a SoCal Citygate premium that has swelled to its widest in three weeks.

items.title: ConocoPhillips Adds Venture Global Deal to Expanding LNG Portfolio
items.summary: ConocoPhillips is deepening its bet on US Gulf Coast LNG, signing a long-term supply deal with Venture Global that extends a recent run of 20-year-plus contracts for US export capacity.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Mount Midday Climb Above $3
items.summary: Having hit an intraday low of $2.912/MMBtu, prompt month natural gas futures probed above $3.00 in late morning trade on diverse regional weather patterns and possible supply constraints.

items.title: US Natural Gas Exports to Mexico Hit September Record as Power Demand Grows
items.summary: September was another strong month for US natural gas exports to Mexico, helping to drive demand for supplies of the fuel from the South Central region.

items.title: Trump Says South Korea Deal Includes $8.4 Billion U.S. Oil Project
items.summary: President Donald Trump said Friday that South Korea’s investment agreement with the United States now includes $8.4 billion for an enhanced oil recovery project. Seoul says it agreed to no such thing. “The Republic of Korea Deal keeps getting BETTER!
